requirement: The cooling system shall maintain available cooling capacity equal to or greater than defined critical cooling demand during required operating periods
The cooling plant shall achieve weighted COP >= 3.30 over the post demonstration period
The maintenance process shall achieve preventive maintenance compliance >= 95 percent
Critical monitoring channels shall have a nominal sampling interval of 60 seconds with daily completeness >= 95 percent
The facility shall achieve modeled PUE <= 1.50 over the post demonstration period within the declared energy boundary
The system shall provide continuous visibility of redundancy state and cooling capacity margin
acceptance_criterion: Redundancy state and capacity margin available for each 15-minute performance interval

requirement: Control supervisory and analytics functions shall implement defined logical separation and least-privilege access
